description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Warrior of Light)] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Warrior of Light)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Holy abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Holy Mode II (Warrior of Light)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Holy Mode II (Warrior of Light)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts speed x9999999 for Holy abilities, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] after using Holy abilities if 0-3 FF1 allies are alive, grants [Buff Holy 20% (15s)] to all allies after using Holy abilities if 0-3 FF1 allies are alive, grants [Damage Cap +10000 2] and [Deadly Strikes +20% 2] to the user if 4+ FF1 allies are alive

description.name: Buff Holy 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% 2
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
